t_park.text:
(1-4)

To: All Staff
From: Daniel Kim, Facilities Manager
Date: June 3
Subject: Parking Lot Closure

Please be advised that the north parking lot will be closed from June 10 to June 14 for resurfacing. During this time, employees may park in the visitor lot on Maple Street or use the free shuttle that runs every 15 minutes between the visitor lot and the main entrance. The shuttle's first pickup is at 7:30 a.m. Employees who normally arrive earlier are encouraged to carpool or use public transportation. The south lot will remain open but is expected to fill quickly. Reserved spaces for disabled employees will not be affected. If you have any questions, please contact me at extension 214.

t_lang.text:
(5-8)

Brightway Language Institute — Evening Courses Begin September 5!

Learn Spanish, French, or Japanese in small classes of no more than eight students. All courses meet twice a week for ten weeks, from 6:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. Tuition is $320 per course, and textbooks are included. Students who register before August 15 receive a 15 percent discount. Anyone who completes a course may take a free placement test for the next level. Classes are held at 48 Harbor Road, a five-minute walk from Central Station. To register, call 555-0142 or visit our front desk.

t_pilot.text:
(9-12)

MEMO
To: Department Heads
From: Sandra Ortiz, Human Resources
Re: Flexible Work Pilot

Beginning next month, HR will launch a three-month pilot allowing employees to work from home up to two days per week. Participation is voluntary and requires approval from an employee's direct supervisor. Employees who choose to participate must be reachable by phone and e-mail during regular business hours and attend all in-person team meetings. At the end of the pilot, we will survey participants and supervisors to decide whether to make the program permanent. Please share this information with your teams and send me a list of interested employees by the 20th.

t_green.text:
(13-16)

Greenfield Foods Expands to Three New Markets

Greenfield Foods announced on Monday that it will open distribution centers in Portland, Denver, and Austin by the end of next year. The expansion, expected to create about 400 jobs, follows a 22 percent rise in sales over the past two years. CEO Marta Hines said the company chose the cities because of strong demand for organic products and access to major highways. "We have grown faster than we planned," she said, "and these new centers will let us deliver fresher products to more customers." Construction on the Portland site is scheduled to begin in March, while the other two sites are still awaiting final permits.

(17-20)

Priya Shah [2:05 p.m.]: Hi Tom, are you still at the client's office?
Tom Reed [2:07 p.m.]: Yes, the meeting ran long. We should finish around 3:30.
Priya Shah [2:08 p.m.]: Okay. The printer is jammed again, and I need the sample brochures before the 5:00 presentation.
Tom Reed [2:10 p.m.]: I can stop by the print shop on Elm Street on my way back. They know our account.
Priya Shah [2:11 p.m.]: That would be great. Ask for the 200 glossy copies we ordered Monday.
Tom Reed [2:12 p.m.]: Will do. I'll be at the office by 4:30.

t_lib.text:
(21-24)

Westbrook Public Library — Summer Hours

From June 1 through August 31, the library will be open Monday to Thursday from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., Friday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and Saturday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. The library will be closed on Sundays and on July 4. Borrowers may check out up to ten items at a time for three weeks. Late fees of 25 cents per day apply to all items except children's books. Visitors can renew items online or by phone, but items that have been requested by another borrower cannot be renewed. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the building.

t_letter.text:
(25-28)

Dear Ms. Walters,

I am writing regarding the dining table I purchased from your store on April 2 (order #48210). Although the table was delivered on time, I discovered a deep scratch along one edge when I unpacked it. I contacted your customer service line twice, and each time I was promised a call back within two business days. No one has called. I would like a replacement table delivered to my address as soon as possible. If a replacement is unavailable, I will accept a full refund. I have attached photographs of the damage and a copy of my receipt.

Sincerely,
Gordon Pratt

t_conf.text:
(29-32)

Annual Sales Conference — Day 1 Schedule

9:00 a.m.  Welcome remarks, Grand Ballroom
9:30 a.m.  Keynote: The Future of Retail (Dr. Helen Cho)
10:45 a.m.  Coffee break
11:15 a.m.  Breakout sessions (choose one): A. Online Sales Strategies, Room 201; B. Customer Loyalty Programs, Room 203; C. Negotiation Skills, Room 205
12:30 p.m.  Lunch, Garden Terrace
2:00 p.m.  Panel discussion: Lessons from Global Markets
3:30 p.m.  Closing remarks and awards

Note: Attendees must wear name badges at all times. Session handouts will be e-mailed after the conference. Because Room 205 has limited seating, participants interested in session C should arrive early.
